response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive tooling experience, and clear leadership in open-source and team education, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership through workshops, open-source projects, and team mentoring
Broad technical stack including mobile (iOS/TV), build systems, and testing infrastructure
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership beyond technical mentorship
Minimal demonstrated experience in mobile platform ecosystems (iOS/Android) as required
Lacks documented experience leading organizational change or strategic roadmap planning at scale
